summary_markdown:
The participants discussed the plan to restructure a data cluster in the evening. Initial steps involve detaching the `/data/local` directory during the day, which someone agreed to handle from the ClickHouse side.

Regarding file permissions for the local data path, [me] decided not to delete the policy but rather move it to a subdirectory within `hot`. The discussion focused on creating the correct folder structure and permissions (e.g., using `sudo chown -R clickhouse:clickhouse`). It was noted that attempting to update the disk path caused an error in the logs, suggesting a restart would be necessary before dismounting.

Later, [p1] confirmed the timing for the restructuring session should be around 9 o'clock, similar to previous instances.
decisions: The data cluster will be restructured this evening.
The local policy path will be moved to a subdirectory within /data/hot instead of being deleted.
action_items: Detach the /data/local directory from ClickHouse during the day.
Ensure the system is restarted before dismounting the disk path due to log errors.
Set up PostgreSQL with encrypted EBS (p1).
